stories.summary: DBS announced chairman Peter Seah will retire on Dec 31 after 16 years, with independent director Anthony Lim succeeding him on Jan 1, 2027.
stories.title: DBS names Anthony Lim as new chairman as Peter Seah retires
stories.why: A leadership change at Singapore's largest bank, whose market value passed S$200 billion in July.

stories.summary: SIA reveals its next-generation First and Business Class suites today, part of a S$1.1 billion refit of 41 A350-900s, with the first refitted jets due back in service in Q1 2027.
stories.title: Singapore Airlines unveils new A350 First and Business cabins today
stories.why: The first meaningful redesign of SIA's long-haul premium cabins in nearly two decades.

stories.summary: Police confirmed open-concept massage establishments lose their licensing exemption from Dec 1 and must obtain a new Category 3 licence, with a one-year grace period; all shops must display a police-issued licence poster.
stories.title: All massage parlours must be licensed from Dec 1
stories.why: A clampdown on vice in heartland shops, after HDB took action in 26 vice cases since January.

stories.summary: Apple's first touchscreen Macs — 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pros with tandem OLED PROLED XDR displays — plus the OLED iPad mini with A20 Pro and new M6 iMac and MacBook Pro begin arriving to customers today.
stories.title: Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pro and OLED iPad mini reach customers today
stories.why: Touchscreens arrive on the Mac for the first time, a major shift in Apple's laptop strategy.

stories.summary: Rockstar released 39 new GTA VI screenshots showing Vice City, Jason and Lucia, two weeks ahead of the Nov 19 launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S; pre-loading starts Nov 10 with a 212GB download.
stories.title: Rockstar drops 39 new GTA 6 screenshots two weeks before launch
stories.why: The most anticipated game launch in a decade enters its final countdown.

stories.summary: Quantum computing firm Quantinuum reported Q3 revenue of US$9.1 million, up 233% year-on-year, and raised its full-year outlook to US$31-34 million; its Helios system is being assembled in Singapore ahead of spring 2027 commissioning.
stories.title: Quantinuum revenue jumps 233% and raises outlook
stories.why: A rare quantum-computing growth story with a direct Singapore footprint.

stories.summary: The Bank of England raised Bank Rate 25 basis points to 4% on an 8-1 vote, warning at least one more increase is likely if the US-Iran conflict continues; UK inflation is forecast to reach about 5% by the middle of next year.
stories.title: Bank of England raises rates to 4%, first hike in over three years
stories.why: A major central bank is hiking again as war-driven energy costs push inflation up, diverging from the Fed's path.

stories.summary: China's National Development and Reform Commission prohibited SoftBank's acquisition of ABB's robotics business in China, dealing a blow to Masayoshi Son's push into physical AI; ABB confirmed it was informed of the block.
stories.title: China blocks SoftBank's US$5.4 billion ABB robotics takeover
stories.why: Beijing is using foreign-investment security reviews to keep robotics data and AI training capability onshore — the second major deal blocked in 2026 after Meta/Manus.

stories.summary: US stocks tumbled overnight, with the Nasdaq 100 down 6.4% and wiping out about US$2.3 trillion in value, as the Democratic midterm sweep fuelled fears of tighter AI and data-centre regulation; Asian chip stocks followed lower.
stories.title: S&P 500 suffers worst day since April 2025 as Nasdaq enters correction
stories.why: The post-midterm rotation is hitting the AI trade that has driven markets all year.

stories.summary: India successfully test-fired its indigenous quasi-ballistic Pralay missile from off the Odisha coast; the 500-1,000 kg payload system is now set for imminent induction into the armed forces.
stories.title: India test-fires Pralay missile; induction imminent
stories.why: Adds a conventional short-range ballistic strike option to India's arsenal.

stories.summary: Trump said the US military is producing weapons at an unprecedented rate and is ready for further action against Iran, even as Tehran sent a new nuclear proposal to Washington via Qatar.
stories.title: Trump says US is "locked and loaded" for further Iran strikes
stories.why: Signals the Iran war may escalate again after the midterms, with oil and regional security in the balance.

stories.summary: Italy is finalising its 13th military aid package for Ukraine, expected to include Aster interceptors for the SAMP/T air-defence system, with the defence minister briefing parliament's intelligence committee on Nov 10.
stories.title: Italy finalising first Ukraine military aid package of the year
stories.why: Kyiv urgently needs air defences against Russian missile and drone attacks on cities and infrastructure.

stories.summary: NewsGuard identified 55 viral false claims about the US midterms across 611 instances; 26 centred on supposed election fraud, and X accounted for 64% of confirmed instances.
stories.title: NewsGuard: 55 false midterm claims debunked, most spreading on X
stories.why: Shows how election-fraud narratives keep circulating after the vote, threatening trust in results.

stories.summary: A New York Times investigation, drawing on Alethea research, found Russia's Operation Doppelgänger running more than 50 fake personas and 1,000 amplifying accounts behind about 150,000 posts on X to spread divisive narratives ahead of elections in the US, Israel and France.
stories.title: Russian influence ops target US, Israel and French elections — NYT
stories.why: Evidence of a coordinated, multi-country Russian influence campaign in an election year.

stories.summary: The Electoral Commission of South Africa warned parties and supporters against spreading unverified local-election results as counting continues, with more than 800 complaints received and 106 still unresolved.
stories.title: South Africa's electoral body warns false results could fuel tensions
stories.why: A live example of how election misinformation can inflame tensions before official results land.

tldr: Singapore: DBS names Anthony Lim as its new chairman as Peter Seah retires after 16 years at the helm.
Technology: Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pro and OLED iPad mini reach customers today.
Finance: The Bank of England raises rates to 4% — its first hike in over three years — blaming the Iran war for inflation heading toward 5%.
Defence: Trump says the US is "locked and loaded" for further strikes on Iran.
Information warfare: NewsGuard debunked 55 false midterm claims, with X hosting 64% of instances.
